digest.component_or_area: compact-all sweep and operation-linked compaction trigger
propositions: Compaction must work in environments with no CI and no local cron by linking to operations, but scheduled sweeps alone leave CI-less stores without an automatic trigger.

The compact-all verb selects only snapshot-less tickets for backfill and never re-folds grown tickets, so it requires two-arm selection: backfill (no snapshot + foldable events) and recurrence (foldable count over threshold).
The fold driver must count only tickets that produce new artifacts, not return codes, since _compact_locked returns 0 for both successful folds and all three no-op branches.
Out-of-band compaction triggered from close must not hold the store lock across the fold, delegating to a detached worker with stamped advisory lock to prevent stalls under sustained contention.
The sweep walk of git full-history runs per-ticket inside the write lock, holding it across tens of minutes on large stores, and must be hoisted out with single-pass batching before the mutations.
